items.subject: Security alert
items.summary: Google detected a new sign-in to Pete's account. The email does not identify the device or location, so the activity must be verified directly in Google Account Security.
items.action: Open Google Account Security directly and confirm whether the new sign-in was yours. If you do not recognise it, secure the account immediately, sign out unknown sessions, change the password and review recovery and two-step verification settings.
items.decisionNeeded: Confirm whether the new Google Account sign-in was yours.
